description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework that delivers Express‑like simplicity with built‑in routing, middleware, and security—ready for edge, serverless, and AI workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Position yantravese as the "Express‑compatible, Fastify‑speed" solution that works everywhere—cloud VMs, serverless functions, and edge runtimes. Emphasize the daily‑build versioning to signal active development, showcase benchmark charts (sub‑millisecond routing, <30 KB install), and tie into 2026 trends: AI‑ready APIs, observable streams, and native TypeScript support without extra packages.
download_hooks: Blazing sub‑millisecond request routing with <0.1 ms overhead per route.
Zero external dependencies → tiny install size (<30 KB) and instant cold‑start on serverless/edge platforms.
Built‑in security headers, rate‑limiting, and full TypeScript typings for a frictionless developer experience.
